clubs.name: The Morning Pages
clubs.description: A welcoming corner for short stories and everyday culture. All levels welcome: a word, a sentence, or a longer reflection belongs here. Start with the bakery story: which detail reminds you of a place that feels like home?

clubs.name: Marianela Reading Circle
clubs.description: Read Marianela at your own pace. All levels welcome. How does the opening landscape shape your first impression? Share a detail, or ask about a word that caught your eye. Short replies and questions are welcome; mark plot spoilers so others can keep discovering.

clubs.name: Marianela Listening Circle
clubs.description: Listen together to the opening chapter of Marianela. All levels welcome: pause, replay, or follow the transcript whenever you like. What sound, phrase, or detail helped you picture the scene? Share a timestamp if useful, and mark spoilers. There is no listening speed to keep up with.

clubs.name: Daisy Bell Song Circle
clubs.description: Explore Daisy Bell through its words, voices, and music. All levels welcome, whether you share a single phrase or a longer thought. Which repeated line or musical moment stays with you, and what mood does it create? Questions about unfamiliar words belong here too; no singing experience needed.
